enter.q: How do I enter a raffle?
enter.a: Open a live raffle, choose your ticket quantity, accept the conditions and complete payment. Your confirmed ticket numbers will then appear under My Tickets.

howMany.q: How many tickets can I buy?
howMany.a: Each raffle shows its own ticket limit before purchase. Choose any quantity from one up to the maximum displayed on that raffle.

whenNumbers.q: When will I receive my ticket numbers?
whenNumbers.a: Ticket numbers are issued after payment is confirmed. You can review them anytime from Profile → My Tickets.

winners.a: Every paid ticket represents one entry. Draw information and confirmed results are published inside YeneEta so you can follow the raffle from entry to result.

reviewPayment.q: Where can I review a payment?
reviewPayment.a: Open Profile to see your payment history and status. If you still need help, call the support number on this page.
